"""M3 浏览器验收：index → coach（答题循环）→ memory，全部带 ?source=auto。"""
import json
import time

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:18802"
LEARNER = "浏览器同学"
SHOT = "../.cache/scratch/"
errors = []

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome", headless=True)
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
    page = ctx.new_page()
    page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append("pageerror: " + str(e)))
    page.on("console", lambda m: errors.append("console: " + m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)

    # 1) 首页：输入学习者 → 开始复习
    page.goto(f"{BASE}/?source=auto")
    page.wait_for_selector("#review-start-btn", timeout=10000)
    page.fill("#learner-name", LEARNER)
    page.click("#review-start-btn")
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#opening-line').textContent.trim().length > 0",
                           timeout=20000)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    print("index opening:", page.inner_text("#opening-line").strip()[:120])
    page.screenshot(path=f"{SHOT}m3_index.png", full_page=True)

    # 2) 复习教练页：开始会话并答一道题
    page.goto(f"{BASE}/coach.html?source=auto")
    page.wait_for_selector("#start-btn", timeout=10000)
    page.fill("#learner-input", LEARNER)
    page.click("#start-btn")
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#quiz-meta').textContent.trim().length > 0",
                           timeout=30000)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    print("coach opening:", page.inner_text("#opening-line").strip()[:120])
    print("question meta:", page.inner_text("#quiz-meta").strip()[:160])
    page.screenshot(path=f"{SHOT}m3_coach_question.png", full_page=True)

    # 按题型作答（故意答一个大概率错误的答案，验证错题记忆路径）
    if page.locator("#quiz-body input[name=opt]").count() > 0:
        page.locator("#quiz-body input[name=opt]").last.check()
        page.click("#answer-btn")
    elif page.locator("#fill-answer").count() > 0:
        page.fill("#fill-answer", "浏览器占位答案")
        page.click("#answer-btn")
    elif page.locator("#short-answer").count() > 0:
        page.fill("#short-answer", "浏览器同学的简答占位。")
        page.click("#answer-btn")
        # 无 LLM 时可能进入自评
        try:
            page.wait_for_selector("#quiz-result button", timeout=8000)
            page.locator("#quiz-result button", has_text="模糊").first.click()
        except Exception:
            pass
    else:
        # 自测题：自评按钮在 quiz-body 里
        page.locator("#quiz-body button", has_text="模糊").first.click()

    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#quiz-result').textContent.trim().length > 0",
                           timeout=60000)
    time.sleep(1)
    print("result:", page.inner_text("#quiz-result").strip()[:260].replace("\n", " | "))
    page.screenshot(path=f"{SHOT}m3_coach_result.png", full_page=True)

    # 3) 我的记忆页
    page.goto(f"{BASE}/memory.html?source=auto")
    page.wait_for_selector("#memory-area", timeout=10000)
    page.fill("#learner-input", LEARNER)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="查看记忆").click()
    page.wait_for_function(
        "document.querySelector('#memory-area').textContent.includes('掌握度卡片')",
        timeout=30000)
    time.sleep(1)
    body = page.inner_text("#memory-area")
    print("memory has mastery:", "掌握度卡片" in body,
          "| mistakes:", "错题" in body,
          "| plan:", "复习计划" in body,
          "| pc_calls:", "请求 / 响应摘要" in body)
    page.screenshot(path=f"{SHOT}m3_memory.png", full_page=True)

    # 4) 回到教练页结束会话（localStorage 已保存 session）
    page.goto(f"{BASE}/coach.html?source=auto")
    page.wait_for_selector("#resume-btn", timeout=10000)
    page.click("#resume-btn")
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#quiz-meta').textContent.trim().length > 0",
                           timeout=30000)
    page.click("#end-btn")
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#opening-line').textContent.includes('会话已结束')",
                           timeout=30000)
    print("session end:", page.inner_text("#opening-line").strip()[:120])
    page.screenshot(path=f"{SHOT}m3_coach_end.png", full_page=True)

    print("js errors:", errors[:5] if errors else "无")
    browser.close()

print("浏览器验收完成 ✅")
